answer.summary: Lower back pain after a fall last week, wants an assessment this week
answer.reply:
Hi Sarah,

Thanks for getting in touch with Harbourline Physio, and sorry to hear about your back. We'd be glad to see you for an initial assessment this week. You can choose a time that suits you here: harbourlinephysio.test/book

If you'd rather we call you to arrange it, just reply to this email.

The Harbourline Physio team
